entry.title: E-2026-002 Twelve more pages map only some of the candidates on the ballot
entry.summary: Open. According to Ballotpedia, these pages show two candidates while more were on the ballot: Georgia, Texas, Nebraska, North Carolina, Kentucky and Michigan for Senate, and Arizona, Michigan, Nevada, Ohio, Wisconsin and Pennsylvania for governor. Shares on these pages are shares of the two shown candidates, not of all votes. California is complete (top-two race). About 40 other pages have not been checked yet.

entry.title: E-2026-001 Montana Senate map shows two of the candidates on the ballot
entry.summary: Disclosed on page. The page maps Seth Bodnar (independent) and Kurt Alme (Republican) only. It leaves out Democrat Alani Bankhead, Libertarian Kyle Austin and one write-in candidate. The headline share is therefore a share of the two shown candidates' votes, not of all votes.
